title: Inflammation and Immunity Gene Expression Patterns and Machine Learning Approaches in Association with Response to Immune-Checkpoint Inhibitors-Based Treatments in Clear-Cell Renal Carcinoma.
summary: A 27-patient ccRCC cohort links pretreatment blood expression and learned models to RECIST response groups; exploratory, without independent replication. The study does not establish external generalization, causal effects or sustained operational impact.
ai_technology: H2O AutoML compared learned classifiers on pre-treatment blood-expression profiles to distinguish RECIST clinical-benefit and progressive-disease groups.
organization: Department of Basic Medical Sciences, Laboratory of Biology, Medical School, National and Kapodistrian University of Athens, Michalakopoulou 176, 11527 Athens, Greece

evidence.tested: The 27-patient study reports response-associated expression patterns and top classifier AUCs of 0.8–1.0.
evidence.unknown: A 60/40 split and cross-validation are described; small cohort, treatment regimens are mixed, and no independent cohort is reported.
evidence.ai_role: H2O AutoML compared learned classifiers on pre-treatment blood-expression profiles to distinguish RECIST clinical-benefit and progressive-disease groups.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
